subject: Charter Study Committee Final Report Drafting
overview: The subcommittee reviewed the structure of the draft final report, finalized the list of major recommendations to include in the executive summary, and organized materials for the appendix. The group also established a strategy for formatting, translating, and publicly releasing the report.

items.title: Review of Draft Report and Comments
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed integrating recent drafting comments and decided to highlight major decisions and their rationales within the report body.

items.title: Appendix Content and Source Materials
items.summary: Members selected official memos from the Collins Center and listening session reports for the appendix to document the committee's research and outreach.

items.title: Survey Results and Public Feedback
items.summary: The committee planned to have survey analytics formatted for the report and decided to provide redacted public comments via a centralized digital link.

items.title: Confidentiality of Stakeholder Interviews
items.summary: The subcommittee decided to list the names and roles of city officials interviewed but will withhold transcripts to maintain confidentiality and encourage open discussion.

items.title: Identification of Major Recommendations
items.summary: Members compiled a list of key recommendations for an executive summary, including hybrid ward representation, mayoral term limits, and enhanced citizen petition mechanisms.

items.title: Document Formatting and Production
items.summary: The group coordinated the final formatting into PDF and Word versions and planned to present a bound physical copy to the mayor.

items.title: Communication and Translation Strategy
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed translating the executive summary and coordinating a press release through the city's communications director.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The subcommittee scheduled its next meeting for July 29 at 10:00 AM to finalize the draft for the full committee.
